# netactuate_tag_resources (Data Source)

Reads Tag Resources visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_tag_resources" "example" {
  tag_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag_id` (Number) Tag ID whose assigned resources will be listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `resources` (List of Object) Resources assigned to the tag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `identifier` (Number)
- `resource_name` (String)
- `resource_tag_id` (Number)
